name: Dessau-Roßlau (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided yellow over red, charged at the centre with the city arms of Dessau-Roßlau (quartered with an eagle, the Saxon bars, a chequy field and a ship, beneath a crenellated chief).
history: Municipal flag of Dessau-Roßlau; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Dessau-Roßlau arms — eagle, Saxon bars, chequy and ship
